given.note: A7-80: someone who is not Alex texts Rosie's number, 'Hi, what time is Alex's haircut tomorrow? I'm picking them up after.' The sender proves nothing, so the answer is the same words every time, true or not: 'This is Rosie, the automated booking assistant for Lee's Barbershop. I can't share anything about anyone's visits. If it's your own booking, I can help with that. Otherwise, the business can call you back about your own question.', quick_reply, in the sender's own chat. Sam is told in the same commit ('Never confirm or deny it to them, even on the call back.'), but nothing of that is answered: the answer names no booking, person, time or row, and is the same whether or not a booking exists (README default 148). The sender has no person row (personId null). No key. The ids are examples.
